# layers/logging/flutter-observability/

Flutter observability standards — one injected AppLogger facade with built-in redaction, the print/debugPrint ban, crash-reporter context and navigation breadcrumbs, the three global error channels, a sealed AnalyticsEvent catalogue with consent checked before collection, and typed feature flags with a fail-open minimum-version gate. Load when writing or reviewing logging, crash reporting, analytics events, remote config or feature flags.

**Skill:** `flutter-observability` · **Stack:** `logging/flutter-observability`
